notes.title: August 2025 Update: Development Progress & New Timeline
notes.content:
[p]Hello Astra Odysseans!
[/p][p]We're writing to you today with an important update on our development and timeline.
[/p][p]This project is a labor of love, and your incredible support has allowed us to raise our ambitions for what this game can truly be. We believe true craftsmanship can't be rushed. To give our ideas the time they need to mature and to integrate all the features we're excited about, we are giving the project more breathing room.[/p][p]Consequently, [b]the Beta is now planned for the end of 2025, with a full release targeted for 2026.[/b]
[/p][p]To show you this extra time is being put to good use, we want to share a [b]major milestone: we have officially finalized all the core city-building gameplay mechanics[/b] for both planetside cities and space structures![/p][p]It also means we have now launched into the full-scale asset production phase. [b]Our artists are hard at work creating the final 3D models[/b] for every building, unit, space station, megastructure, and more.[/p][p]For cities, our goal was to create architectural styles versatile enough for any civilization type you choose to play. To bring this to life, we've defined several distinct styles. Here’s a first look:[/p][list][*][p][b]Utility:[/b] A functional style defined by industrial concrete and metal. Built for efficiency and resilience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BioShape:[/b] An organic style inspired by natural shapes, featuring flowing structures and a warm, beige color scheme.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182235/1ee3ccb4b65a0ccbd9479dc281fbdd3ab8e37a2f.png"][/img]This image shows the [b]Alloy Factory[/b] (left), the [b]Solar Panel Field[/b] (center), and the [b]Scientific Laboratory[/b] (right) in both styles. Other architectural styles are planned for the game's launch.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Technical Update:[/b] We are continuing to advance the game's AI/bot systems and are also finalizing the lore and quests that will make your journey unique. This july and august, we are also focusing on a significant improvements to lighting, shadows, and the game's overall atmosphere, as well as enriching the fauna and flora you will discover across all 20 biomes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s Next?[/b] Our next major milestone is launching the [b]Beta at the end of this year[/b]. If you’re interested in getting more frequent updates and want a chance to be among the first to play, we invite you to join our community on [url="https://discord.gg/cvZnUST"][u]Discord[/u][/url]![/p][p][/p][p]On an exciting final note, [b]we'll be participating in the 4X Fest on Steam next week![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182235/bca3622c30db3300b72a3f4018b5c5a4b603475f.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for your incredible patience and continued support. We're building something we're extremely proud of, and we can't wait to share it with you.[/p][p][/p][p]Toward Astra and beyond!
Alex & Valentin[/p]

notes.title: Update on Beyond Astra: Galaxies Show, Beta Progress and More!
notes.content:
Hello, We hope you’re all doing well! We've been busy working on the beta for Beyond Astra and wanted share a quick update on our progress.

[h3]Our goal with Beyond Astra is to create an immersive 4X grand strategy experience, blending elements of city-building and RTS gameplay; a game where exploration, expansion, and conquest unfold seamlessly on 3D planets and in space. This is a childhood dream we’ve been bringing to life for the past five years, pushing the limits of one of the most innovative game engines out there.[/h3]

We're really grateful for all the enthusiasm you've shown for the game! A huge thank you to everyone who backed our Kickstarter campaign. Late pledges are still open if you’d like to get involved.

We're also happy to share that we received a grant from the French state to help us finish development. Every bit of funding goes directly into making Beyond Astra the best version it can be. Valentin and I are working hard every day to make that happen.

Lately, we've focused a lot on improving the user interface (UI) and overall experience. Our goal is to make everything clear and intuitive, so you can focus on your strategy. Key improvements include:
[list]
[*] A cleaner, easier-to-read UI for managing your empire
[*] Customizable city templates to simplify colony building.
[*] A central management interface for smoother gameplay.
[/list]
We're also adding more detail to the game's visuals and gameplay: new environments, units, and creatures! Here’s a little sneak peek.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182235/6fd1d80206b241ab5b49b156a9cf59b8ea133e22.jpg[/img]

[h3]Speaking of showing more, we're excited to be part of the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/galaxiesshow]Galaxies Show on Twitch![/url] Tune in on April 17th at 8pm UK / 9pm CEST / 12pm Pacific / 3pm Eastern. It'll be a great opportunity to reveal more visuals and give you a clearer picture of what we're aiming for with the beta.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182235/fa767598136660b6a3b2d8a5de4d7526c376fcfe.jpg[/img]

Because the game has changed so much, the old alpha preview doesn't really show what Beyond Astra looks like now. We'll be taking it down in the next few days. Thank you so much for all the valuable feedback you shared on the alpha, it helped us a lot!

Thanks again for your continued support and patience. We're excited for you to see everything we've been working on!

Best,
Alex & Valentin

notes.title: Final Days to Support Beyond Astra!
notes.content:
[h3]The celebration of [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nebulegames/beyondastra/]Beyond Astra’s Kickstarter campaign[/url] continues for just 4 more days! Help us spread the word, your support is invaluable as we approach the final days.[/h3]

We’re taking all of your suggestions seriously and appreciate each one.

In response to many requests, we’ve decided to launch Beyond Astra on [b]multiple platforms[/b]: Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG. You’ll be able to choose the platform on which to redeem your game key.

[b]Language Update[/b]: We’re excited to add Czech to our planned languages, bringing the total to 14!

[b]Does the Game Include the Solar System?[/b] While some pioneers originate from the Solar System, each game takes place in unique, fictional galaxies or galaxy branches.

[b]AI Art Concerns:[/b] Rest assured, we won’t be using AI art for Beyond Astra. We’re committed to collaborating with talented artists, which is also one of the core reasons for this Kickstarter!

[b]An Awesome OST?[/b] Valentin, Beyond Astra’s creator and coder, is also a film music composer. He’s putting his heart into the soundtrack as much as the game itself, and we can’t wait for you to hear it.

[b]Seeing the Project Through:[/b] We’re fully committed and have worked daily on this project for five years. We’re young, motivated, and ready to face any challenge that comes our way! This project is like our own baby, and we’re dedicated to making it the best it can be for release.

[b]Battlemechs Request:[/b] We see many fans of Planetary Annihilation! We’re currently reworking the ground combat system (see our previous update), which means redesigning land units. We’ll create a variety of unit styles and are keeping your ideas in mind. 😊

Thank you so much for your incredible support and enthusiasm!
Alex & Valentin

notes.title: Insights from the alpha preview and Next Steps
notes.content:
[h3]We want to take a moment to thank each of you for being part of this journey.[/h3]
We have been working on Beyond Astra for five years, and since our official announcement in early September, your support has exceeded all our expectations. Within days, our YouTube video went viral, and in just a few weeks, more than ten thousand of you added Beyond Astra to your wishlists.

In October, we released an alpha preview of the game to showcase the innovations we’ve developed over the years and give you a taste of the gameplay while exploring new features we have in mind. Beyond Astra is our first game, and also through this alpha preview release we wanted to try out our approach to project publication.

Thanks to your support during the October Steam Next Fest, we ranked in the global Top 100 and Top 3 in the 4X category of the event, and now tens of thousands of you have Beyond Astra on your wishlist!

From the alpha preview, we received hundreds of valuable feedback, which we’ve read one by one. Many of you are enthusiastic and see the game’s potential, and you’ve also highlighted improvements needed to ensure Beyond Astra becomes the best version it can be. We cannot thank you enough for the time you’ve taken to share your ideas, advice, and suggestions. Your input will significantly impact the final game and our plans moving forward.
[h3]Here are the changes we plan to implement based on your feedback:

[/h3][h2]Gameplay[/h2][list]
[*] [h3]Redesign of Ground Combat System[/h3] We are shifting to an RTS ground combat system with larger individual units, each with specific roles and utilities from start to end game. This will create a more cohesive gameplay experience between space and ground combat, allowing for a better understanding of what is happening during battles and adding depth to the gameplay.
[*] [h3]City Defense System Overhaul[/h3] We will replace city garrisons with turret modules (which you can choose) surrounding cities and space stations. This change will help distinguish between space/orbital and ground ship production, as all units will now be produced directly from the city and deployed immediately (removing the need for garrisons).[/list]
[h2]UI/UX[/h2][list]
[*] [h3]User Interface Redesign [/h3]We’re making the UI more colorful and clear, with added overlays and explanations for each item, as well as key at-a-glance information like attack notifications and enhanced management alerts. Feedback for actions will be improved with better building distinction, visual effects upon building completion, unit path indicators, and clearer enemy identification.
[*] [h3]Quality of life Improvements[/h3] A single click on the planet will enable unit landing, with an option to specify a landing area where an unobstructed point will be automatically chosen. Expedition Builder will build in queue. City production queue will be expanded to ten times their current capacity. Auto-link extractors with the nearest city. Module lists will appear directly on slots in ship designer.
[*] [h3]Spaceships[/h3] We’re adding spatial pathfinding and improved unit formations. And yellow gravity zone that rotates with the planet will serve as a speed boost.
[*] [h3]Camera Control Enhancements[/h3] We’re enhancing unit selection from space, enabling instant arrival in cities and quick actions from space. We’re also improving mouse fluidity, adding scroll speed options, and clarifying control shortcuts. (Note: The camera is closely tied to Beyond Astra’s unique features. While we aim to make it as intuitive as possible, it may require a brief adjustment period).[/list]
[h2]Macro Management[/h2][list]
[*] We confirm that interfaces for performing group actions across your galactic-scale empire are planned.
[*] A copy-paste system and automation for city designs will allow you to easily replicate cities across planets.[/list]
[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2][list]
[*] Improved visuals on the dark side of the planet to ensure it looks as beautiful and clear as the sunlit side.
[*] We will move away from lengthy dialogue quests, favoring shorter context paragraphs instead.
[*] We confirm a save feature will be included.[/list]

Thank you for all the enthusiasm you share with us! We sincerely apologize to anyone who felt frustrated during the alpha preview, and we are committed to doing much better in our upcoming updates. Your energy and support inspire us to strive for excellence, and we look forward to meeting and exceeding your expectations for the final game.

Best,
Alex & Valentin

notes.title: Beyond Astra Demo Now Available at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[h3]We’re excited to announce that the demo for Beyond Astra is now live as part of the Steam Next Fest! 🎉 [/h3]
This alpha preview allows you to experience the early game through a tutorial, featuring scientist Lu on her quest to conquer her second planet and advance her research. Encounter pirates, build your city, engage with characters Niassah and Theomius, and enjoy intense battles on land and in space!
We created this demo to involve players as early as possible.
Please note that many features shown on our Steam page aren’t available in the demo but will be included in the final version as we continue development.

[h3][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nebulegames/beyondastra]Our Kickstarter campaign launches today! 🥳[/url] [/h3]
This is your chance to pre-order the game and unlock exclusive digital and physical content.

[h3]Tips for the demo[/h3]
[strike]Watch out—gravity is a tough opponent in the demo! Maneuver your ships carefully to avoid the red zones. We’re planning to implement spatial pathfinding for smoother interstellar travel in the final version. [/strike]
[Update 121] Great news! Ships can no longer enter the gravity zone.
For more tips, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2669060/discussions/0/4702412621940529216/]check out our FAQ[/url] 

[h3]Your Feedback Matters[/h3]
Your feedback is invaluable as we prepare for the full release next year. We’ve made daily updates based on your suggestions and will continue to do so this week. While the demo will stay available after the fest, please note we’ll shift focus to the main build next week, so no further updates for the demo will follow.

Dive in, explore, have fun and help us make Beyond Astra amazing! Thank you for your support—we can’t wait to hear your thoughts! 🚀
